sentences.text:
---
 Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay
 ---
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Arvind Kumar Choudhary, Advocate
 For the Opp. Party : A.P.P.
 ---
 04/10.11.2017
Defect no. 9 (I) seems to have been removed.
So far as the defect no. 9 (ii) is concerned, the same is ignored.
It has been stated by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner that there is no compliance of Section 13 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
The learned counsel further submits that the petitioner is in custody since 08.11.2017.
Call for the lower court record.
List this case immediately after receipt of the same under the heading "For Orders".

During the pendency of this application, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Deoghar in G.O.C.R. Case No. 09 of 2005 corresponding to T. R. No. 695 of 2013.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) Umesh/-
